token.title: Verification Token
token.description: Paste a verification token from PerfectDraft's website. See the [setup instructions](https://github.com/Falkvinge/hassio-integration-perfectdraft-pro#step-2-verification-token) for the 30-second walkthrough. The token expires in 2 minutes, so generate it right before pasting.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PerfectDraft
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Please re-enter your credentials.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed: {reason}. Try again with a fresh token.
error.invalid_credentials: PerfectDraft rejected the email or password: {reason}.
error.token_rejected: PerfectDraft rejected the verification token: {reason}. Generate a fresh token and paste it within 2 minutes.

abort.already_configured: This PerfectDraft account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: Those credentials are for a different PerfectDraft account. Re-authenticate with the account this integration was set up with, or delete the integration and add the other account separately.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this PerfectDraft account is already under way. Finish or cancel the pending flow first — look for it under Settings > Devices & Services.
